scope.rule: External observations without a fresh read in this audit are dated and labeled last-known. Local source, tests, rendering, deployment, and operating behavior are separate evidence stages.

stageValues.verified_local: Direct repository source or a retained local execution receipt verifies this stage.
stageValues.partial_local: Some requested behavior is implemented or locally exercised, but the full requested scope is not verified.
stageValues.last_known_external: A dated external readback exists but was not refreshed in this audit and does not prove the entire request.
stageValues.not_verified: No sufficient directly linked evidence closes this stage.
stageValues.not_applicable: This evidence stage does not apply to the request.
